hook: banal 是陳腐台詞，bane 是禍根，bale 是災禍——道具櫃三格：無聊、禍根、災難。
script: banal＝陳腐老套。bane＝禍因／禍根。bale＝災禍不幸。道具師：台詞無聊≠世界末日；bane of my existence 是禍根，不是 bale 整包棉花。

members.senseAnchor: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 無聊格: banal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「無聊格」出場：banal 一上場梗就黏住——陳腐的。

related.synonyms: commonplace, hackneyed, old-hat, shopworn, stock, threadbare
